.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; max-width:1920px; margin:0 auto; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:Pretendard, 'Noto Sans Regular';}
._evt_hide {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}

._lb ._lb_tit {position:absolute; left:0; top:120px; width:100%; font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:60px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-1.2px; line-height:80px; color:#214C67; text-align:center;}
._lb ._deco {position:absolute; font-family:'Cormorant', serif; font-weight:600; color:#3E4F5B; opacity:0.5; line-height:normal; white-space:nowrap;}

._lb ._pick ._pill {display:flex; align-items:center; height:41px; padding:10.8px 18px; border-radius:54px; font-size:16.2px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.49px; line-height:19px; white-space:nowrap;}
._lb ._pick ._name {display:block; margin-top:15.3px; font-size:20.7px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-0.62px; line-height:25px; text-align:center; white-space:normal; word-break:keep-all;}
._best ._best_tit {font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:60px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-1.8px; line-height:80px; color:#214C67; text-align:center;}
._best ._cate_tit {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:48px; font-size:40px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-1.2px; line-height:48px; color:#161616;}
._best ._item_obj ._item ._thumb {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:231px; height:231px; background:#E5E5E5; overflow:hidden;}

._best ._item_obj ._item ._desc {display:-webkit-box; min-height:36px; margin-top:10px; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:18px;}
._best ._item_obj ._item ._price_per {position:absolute; left:0; top:9px; font-size:30px; font-weight:700; line-height:36px; color:#DD153E;}
._best ._item_obj ._item ._price_del {position:absolute; left:105px; top:0; font-size:15px; font-weight:400; line-height:18px; color:#999999; text-decoration:line-through; opacity:0.99;}
._best ._item_obj ._item ._price_doller {position:absolute; left:105px; top:18px; font-size:20px; font-weight:700; line-height:24px; color:#000000;}
._event ._gift li {display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:15px; width:231px; list-style:none;}

._event ._gift ._badge {position:absolute; left:15px; top:15px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:76px; height:76px; border-radius:900px; background:#DD153E; font-family:Avenir, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-0.16px; line-height:18px; color:#FFFFFF; z-index:1;}

._event ._more {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:431px; height:50px; margin:62px auto 0; background:#05446D; font-size:18px; font-weight:600; line-height:21px; color:#FFFFFF;}
